note: Recompiler-only names for static (boot segment) libultra functions whose inventory name is not their identity. N64Recomp replaces libultra functions BY NAME with N64ModernRuntime implementations (reimplemented list) or drops them (ignored list), so a wrong inventory name either swaps the wrong function for a host one (e.g. the inventory's osViSetMode is osViSwapBuffer) or leaves a real libultra function recompiled, poking hardware state the host never services (e.g. the inventory's osSetTimerIntr is osViSetEvent). gen_config.py renames these functions in the recompiler's symbol file only; the inventory, layout and coverage are unchanged. 'recomp' is the canonical libultra name when the function is one N64Recomp/N64ModernRuntime knows; a displaced function whose canonical name is not on N64Recomp's lists, or is uncertain, gets a descriptive name with suffix _rx so it stays emitted. Evidence is the body (src/rom/*.c or asm/us/nonmatchings/rom/**.s). Audit: lane w21r compared every static function 0x80006A00-0x80010400 and every os*/__os* name with ultralib (VERSION_J) and scanned every jal in the static ROM and the game image; names ending in _rx are non-canonical on purpose (true identity in the evidence).
